name: Azriel
overview: Azriel was a male leader from the tribe of Manasseh, recognized as the head of households within his tribe. His role is specifically noted in 1 Chronicles 5:24, highlighting his position of responsibility and governance among his people. There are no additional personal notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Azriel means 'G-d is my help,' reflecting a reliance on divine assistance. This proper name, as recorded in 1 Chronicles 5:24, emphasizes a spiritual dimension to his identity, though it was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Azriel as a descendant of Manasseh, linking him genealogically to this tribe. Beyond this tribal affiliation, no further family relationships are recorded in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Azriel's significance lies in his leadership role within the tribe of Manasseh, serving as head of households, which denotes a position of authority and stewardship. His mention in 1 Chronicles 5:24 situates him within the genealogical and administrative framework of Israel, illustrating the organized tribal structure God established. Through his name and office, Azriel exemplifies a faithful servant relying on God's help in guiding his community.
